_doc: MODEL-TWIN BUDGET — every run of code SHARED by an independent model and the component it judges, DECLARED. SINGLE SOURCE, consumed by test/model-twin-gate.test.js. DETECTION is NOT here: it lives in src/model-twin-pure.js (tokenize + sharedRuns), which knows no exemption. Strict separation of powers — the detector detects, this file plus its test carry the POLICY and the RATCHET.
_doc_why: This repository owns models whose ONLY reason to exist is to CONTRADICT the engine. On 2026-08-23 cadence-spec.js was found to have copied the SHAPE of gate.js: both wrote { seen: true, sinceLastCall: entry.sinceLastCall + 1 }, the engine dropped the denied flag and the model dropped the same flag, so 11,346 exhaustive cases were GREEN on a production bug from the day they were written. A model that copies its defendant cannot contradict it: it only proves that a copy agrees with itself.
_doc_derivation: THE PAIRS ARE DERIVED, NEVER LISTED (a list only knows the past). A MODEL is a src module that is (1) PURE, (2) deliberately OUTSIDE stryker mutate, (3) imported by NO production module — it exists only to be confronted — and (4) confronted by a suite that also imports mutated modules. The JUDGED set of a pair is exactly those mutated modules. Condition (3) is what separates a model from a shared core (pretool-core) or a data table (harness-profile): without it the derivation returned 19 pairs, 12 of them meaningless.
_doc_min: THE THRESHOLD IS 12 TOKENS AND IT WAS CHOSEN BY MEASUREMENT ON 2026-08-23. The 2026-08-23 defect is a 13-token statement on ONE line, so any window above 13 is blind to it by construction; 12 leaves one token of margin. NOISE FLOOR, measured on 10 CONTROL pairs of engine files that share a subject but judge nothing: 12 tokens = 3 runs over 10 pairs (harness boilerplate, longest 16), 10 tokens = 4 runs, 14 tokens = 3 runs, 18 tokens = 0. REFUSED READINGS, with their numbers: jscpd at any setting from 5 lines/50 tokens down to 1 line/10 tokens has ZERO sensitivity (identical counts with and without the defect restored) because its window is a LINE window and it emits no file name; 18 tokens is silent on the control but loses the defect run and 15 of the 34 twins measured today.
_doc_classes: CLOSED list. CONTRACT = the run is a shared SIGNATURE or vocabulary the differential REQUIRES (same arity, same order): an act of instruction, so a written why of at least 60 characters is REQUIRED. INHERITED_TWIN = the measurement of the day, EXEMPT from justification ON PURPOSE — nobody has instructed these runs one by one, and demanding a sentence per run would produce INVENTED ones, which would then make each case look settled. A false justification is worse than none.
_doc_ratchet: THE RATCHET IS AN EQUALITY ON THE RUNS THEMSELVES, never on a count. A count would be blind to the 2026-08-23 defect, which REPLACED one shared statement by another without changing how many there were. An observed run absent from shared = a NEW twin: rewrite the model in its own words, or declare it with its class. A declared run no longer observed = a DORMANT PERMIT and it REDDENS, so an exemption that stops being necessary cannot rot. A pair absent from pairs is held at ZERO.
_doc_exit: EXIT CONDITION of the whole file: zero INHERITED_TWIN entry. Leaving a twin means REWRITING the model statement in the model own words — quantifiers, a partition, a table. Never by deleting the model, and never by relaxing the threshold.
